answer: Yes, we buy cars with open safety recalls, and an open recall doesn't change your offer; you can have it fixed for free at a dealer for your car's brand first, but you don't have to. The help center doesn't cover whether an open insurance claim affects our ability to buy your car, so please contact a store about that part. For the hail damage itself, list it on the damage disclosure form (NW-DMG-1) before the inspection, since disclosed damage is already priced into your offer and doesn't lower it again.
